name: Anduril

summary.text: Anduril Industries is a US defence technology company. Its CEO said it was founded in 2017. Its revenue doubled to $2.2 billion in 2025, according to the company's own announcement as reported by TechCrunch.

facts.claim: In 2025 Anduril raised $2.5 billion at a $30.5 billion valuation, led by Founders Fund.
facts.quote: it raised $2.5 billion at a $30.5 billion valuation led by Founders Fund.

facts.claim: In May 2026 Anduril raised $5 billion at a $61 billion valuation, led by Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz.
facts.quote: Anduril has raised a $5 billion Series H round at a $61 billion valuation, led by returning investors Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz

connections.claim: Founders Fund invested a $1 billion check in Anduril's 2025 round, the largest check it has written, according to TechCrunch.
connections.quote: Founder's Fund invested a $1 billion check, the largest check it has ever written, it told TechCrunch at the time.
